```plato

    // The valence of every vertex: how many undirected edges meet at it.
    VertexValences(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology): Array<Integer>
        => self.Positions.Count.MapRange(v => topology.UndirectedEdges.Count
            .MapRange(e => PairTouches(topology.UndirectedEdges[e], v) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit));
```
